reviews.content: As a first-time mom, this book has been absolutely wonderful in giving me confidence that birth is a natural, normal process, not something to be feared. The first half of the book is entirely birth stories from a huge range of moms, from young to old, high- to low-risk, long and short labors and with babies in a variety of positions. The stories are very comprehensive and helpful for any woman looking ahead to birth. The second half of the book is Ina May's discussion of birth, different birthing theories and positions. I found it especially helpful learning about how much a woman's ability to stay relaxed and comfortable impacts the speed of birthing. It makes so much sense that a woman who feels comfortable in the room and with the people around her is going to have an easier birth experience. Overall a superbly helpful book.
reviews.title: Such an informative, comforting read

reviews.content: This book is a must read for anyone who is expecting, whether or not you are having your first child or your fifth. The stories are very inspiring and are a great way for an expecting mother to prepare for childbirth. Instead of listening to women tell ""horror"" stories about their birthing experiences in hospitals due to intervention you can fill your mind with these positive stories about how a woman can trust in her body tto do what it was made to do naturally.

reviews.content: Having already decided that as a first time mother, that a natural birth was the way I wanted to go. This book has given me the encouragement and knowledge that my body is well capable and more then adequate to give birth. Not only did it give me that extra ""power"" I needed it informed me well on ""routine"" practices that many doctors make us believe are required to have a healthy birth. I would recommend this book to everyone who is having their first child or tenth. I would recommend it to those who would like a ""natural"" childbirth or a medicated childbirth.
